details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1-K4, K5, K7-K9, capturing key financial results, product launches, geographic expansion, and major funding activities. However, it omits critical information regarding AI voice agent pilot implementation (K6), impairment expense details (K10), regulatory challenge in Moldova (K11), and post-reporting period funding (K12). These omissions involve HIGH-importance items (K10, K11) and a MEDIUM item (K12), impacting the completeness assessment. The absence of K6 (MEDIUM) further reduces coverage. While the main picture is captured, the missing HIGH-importance items prevent a 'Yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of record financial performance. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues. The summary flows from revenue performance to key financial metrics, capital management actions, and supporting business developments. While there are multiple numerical figures presented, none of them are presented as exhaustive additive components of the same total that would create arithmetic contradictions. The structure is clear and progressive, covering performance highlights, financial metrics, capital actions, and strategic developments without unnecessary repetition.
